owner_exceptions.statement: A Strategy Risk or Risk Rule breach on a funded account is a soft breach with a reset. It does not terminate or close the account.

overrides_detail.17437285: Breaking this rule can lead to closure of the funded account and loss of its profit.
overrides_detail.17437388: Risking more than 50% of your daily loss limit on one instrument in a day (funded): account closed, you can reset it.

strategy_risk.sentence: A Strategy Risk or Risk Rule breach on a funded account is a soft breach with a reset.
strategy_risk.locator: owner-final exception. Overrides 17437285 "Breaking this rule can lead to closure of the funded account and loss of its profit." and the 17437388 hard-breach cell "Risking more than 50% of your daily loss limit on one instrument in a day (funded): account closed, you can reset it."

strategy_risk.sentence: It does not terminate or close the account.
strategy_risk.locator: owner-final exception. The breach does not terminate or close the account. Daily and max loss limits are not this rule.

daily_loss_hard.sentence: Touching the daily loss limit or the max loss limit is a hard breach.
daily_loss_hard.locator: 17437388 hard-breach column: "Touching the daily or max loss limit."

daily_loss_hard.sentence: A hard breach ends the account.

hard_breach.sentence: A hard breach ends the account.

Hard breaches include touching the daily or max loss limit, fraud, KYC fraud or chargebacks, group trading or IP sharing, account management or passing services, scalp profit above the scalp limit in evaluation, and a repeated soft breach after a warning.
hard_breach.locator: 17437388 hard-breach column, excluding the 50% instrument cell because the owner-final exception overrides that cell.

hard_breach.sentence: In evaluation, a hard breach on 1-Step or 2-Step with Free Retry triggers the free retry automatically, unless the cause is fraud.
hard_breach.locator: 17437388: "In evaluation, a hard breach on 1-Step or 2-Step + Free Retry triggers your free retry automatically, unless the cause is fraud."

soft_kinds.sentence: A soft breach keeps the account open and you must correct your trading.
soft_kinds.locator: 17437388: "A soft breach keeps the account open but has consequences and needs you to correct your trading."

soft_kinds.sentence: It includes an isolated trade under the minimum holding time, scalp profit under the limit, an IP flag with an honest explanation, a hedging flag with no link to another trader, and a first case of gambling-style trading.
soft_kinds.locator: 17437388 soft-breach column: isolated trades under the minimum holding time and scalp profit under the limit; IP flags with an honest explanation; hedging flags with no link to another trader; a first case of gambling-style trading.

instrument_cap.sentence: On a funded account you may not risk more than 50% of your daily loss limit on the same instrument in one trading day.
instrument_cap.locator: 17437285: "On a funded account you may not risk more than 50% of your daily loss limit on the same instrument in one trading day, counting all trades on that instrument in both directions." The closure sentence in that article is not used.

instrument_cap.sentence: A 3% daily loss limit means 1.5% on that instrument, 4% means 2%, and 5% means 2.5%.
Example: a 2-Step $100,000 account has a $2,500 limit.
Trades of $1,000 and $1,500 on the same instrument reach that limit.
instrument_cap.locator: 17437285 example: EURUSD $1,000 at risk and another EURUSD trade $1,500 at risk reach $2,500.

soft_breach_payout.sentence: After a soft breach on a funded account, the account is not closed.
soft_breach_payout.locator: 17437398: "The account is not closed and you are notified by email."

soft_breach_payout.sentence: The current payout is still processed at a 30% reward share, and the payout cycle restarts from payout 1, which also restarts the fee-refund count.
soft_breach_payout.locator: 17437398: current payout still processed at a 30% reward share, and the payout cycle restarts from payout 1, which also restarts the fee-refund count.

soft_breach_payout.sentence: If it happens again after the warning, the account can be reset and its profit forfeited.
soft_breach_payout.locator: 17437398: "If it happens again after the warning, the account can be reset and its profit forfeited."

soft_breach_payout.sentence: In evaluation, the team may reset the account using a free retry if you still have one.
soft_breach_payout.locator: 17437398: "In evaluation, the team may reset your account, using your free retry if you still have it."

weekend_hold.sentence: You can always hold positions from Friday to Monday.
weekend_hold.locator: 17437306 intro: "You can always hold positions from Friday to Monday."

weekend_hold.sentence: Holding an open position over the weekend is allowed without the Weekend Trading add-on and allowed with the add-on.
weekend_hold.locator: 17437306 table "Hold an open position": Without add-on Allowed; With add-on Allowed.

weekend_hold.sentence: Moving your stop loss or take profit over the weekend is allowed without the Weekend Trading add-on and allowed with the add-on.
weekend_hold.locator: 17437306 table "Move your stop loss or take profit": Without add-on Allowed; With add-on Allowed.

weekend_hold.sentence: Closing a position over the weekend, including a stop loss or take profit being hit, is a violation without the Weekend Trading add-on and is allowed only with the add-on.
weekend_hold.locator: 17437306 table "Close a position, including a stop loss or take profit being hit": Without add-on Violation; With add-on Allowed.

weekend_trade.sentence: Trading on Saturday or Sunday needs the Weekend Trading add-on.
weekend_trade.locator: 17437306 intro: "Trading on Saturday and Sunday needs the Weekend Trading add-on."

weekend_trade.sentence: Opening a new position without the add-on is a violation.
weekend_trade.locator: 17437306 table "Open a new position": Without add-on Violation.

weekend_trade.sentence: With the add-on it is allowed.
weekend_trade.locator: 17437306 table "Open a new position": With add-on Allowed.

weekend_trade.sentence: A fill on Saturday or Sunday counts as weekend trading.
weekend_trade.locator: 17437306 callout: "a fill on Saturday or Sunday counts as weekend trading."

weekend_trade.sentence: In evaluation the account may be reset with a free retry or reinstated.
weekend_trade.locator: 17437306 consequence: "in evaluation the account may be reset with your free retry or reinstated."

weekend_trade.sentence: On a funded account it is reset and the current cycle's profit is forfeited.
weekend_trade.locator: 17437306 consequence: "On a funded account it is reset and the current cycle's profit is forfeited."

rise_fee.sentence: Rise is available for withdrawals of $500 or more.
rise_fee.locator: 17437354 table: Rise available for withdrawals of $500 or more.

rise_fee.sentence: A $4,800 reward through Rise arrives as $4,760.
rise_fee.locator: 17437354 example: "a $4,800 reward through Rise arrives as $4,760."

crypto_fee.sentence: Crypto (USDC) is available for any amount and is the only method below $500.
crypto_fee.locator: 17437354 table: Crypto (USDC) any amount, the only method below $500.

crypto_fee.sentence: The fee is 3% of the amount.

crypto_fee.locator: 17437354 example: "A $400 reward in crypto arrives as $388."

payout_timing.sentence: Approved rewards are paid within 5 business days of approval.
payout_timing.locator: 17437354: "approved rewards are paid within 5 business days of approval."

payout_timing.sentence: Bank transfers then take 1 to 3 days.
If a review is needed first, it is finished within 30 days.
payout_timing.locator: 17437354: "If we need to review your account first, we tell you what we are checking and finish within 30 days."

payout_timing.sentence: In some cases the reward is paid back to the original payment method, and you are told before it is sent.
payout_timing.locator: 17437354: in some cases the reward is paid back to the original payment method, and you are told before it is sent.

catalyst_rules.sentence: On every Catalyst stage the profit target is 8% of the stage balance, with options of 5%, 8%, and 10%, and there is no time limit.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "Profit target 8% of the stage balance (options 5%, 8%, 10%), no time limit."

catalyst_rules.sentence: The daily loss limit is 3%, based on the higher of yesterday's closing balance or equity.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "Daily loss 3%, based on the higher of yesterday's closing balance or equity."

catalyst_rules.sentence: Max loss is trailing equity: 6% on the $25,000 stage and 5% from $50,000 up.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "Max loss trailing equity: 6% on the $25K stage, 5% from $50K up."

catalyst_rules.sentence: It rises with equity and never moves down.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "It rises with your equity and never moves down."

catalyst_rules.sentence: You need 5 profitable days, each with at least one trade and the stage's minimum P&L.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "5 profitable days, each with at least one trade and the stage's minimum P&L."

catalyst_rules.sentence: The consistency rule is 30% and can be removed at checkout.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "30% consistency rule (can be removed at checkout)."

catalyst_rules.sentence: The first payout is after 14 days, then every 7, 14, or 21 days as chosen at checkout.
catalyst_rules.locator: 17437215: "First payout after 14 days; after that, every 7, 14 or 21 days as chosen at checkout."

catalyst_ladder.sentence: Catalyst doubles after every approved payout, up to a $1,000,000 account and a 95% reward share.
catalyst_ladder.locator: 17437215: doubles after every approved payout, up to $1,000,000 and a 95% reward share.

catalyst_ladder.sentence: Stage 1 is $25,000, 80% share, $150 minimum P&L per profitable day, and no reset.
Starting from $50,000 begins at stage 2 with an 80% share, rising 5 points per approved payout up to 95%.
catalyst_ladder.locator: 17437215: "Starting from $50,000, you begin at stage 2 with an 80% share, rising 5 points per approved payout up to 95%."

catalyst_reopen.sentence: Each approved Catalyst payout closes the account and opens a fresh one at double the size, with new limits.
catalyst_reopen.locator: 17437215: "each approved payout closes your account and opens a fresh one at double the size, with new limits."

catalyst_reopen.sentence: This is automatic, or done by the team within 24 hours.
catalyst_reopen.locator: 17437215: "This is automatic, or done by our team within 24 hours."

catalyst_stage_reset.sentence: If you breach after your first Catalyst stage, you can buy one reset at that stage instead of starting over.
catalyst_stage_reset.locator: 17437215: "Breach after your first stage? You can buy one reset at that stage instead of starting over."

catalyst_stage_reset.sentence: Your first stage, the $25,000 or $50,000 account you bought, has no reset.
catalyst_stage_reset.locator: 17437215: "Your first stage (the $25K or $50K you bought) has no reset."

reset_eligibility.sentence: A funded reset is allowed only while the account is at breakeven or in profit.
reset_eligibility.locator: 17437410: "only while the account is at breakeven or in profit."

reset_eligibility.sentence: It is not allowed in a loss or in drawdown.
reset_eligibility.locator: owner-final: a funded reset is never allowed in drawdown or loss. 17437410 states the same limit as breakeven or profit only.

reset_count.sentence: A funded account can be reset up to 3 times.

reset_price.sentence: The first funded reset is 40% of the original challenge price before discounts, including add-ons, with a minimum of $10.
reset_price.locator: 17437410: "1st reset: 40% of the original challenge price (before discounts, including add-ons), minimum $10."

reset_price.sentence: The second reset doubles the first.
The third reset doubles the second.
Example: a 1-Step $100,000 account bought at $569 resets for $228, then $456, then $912.
reset_price.locator: 17437410 example: 1-Step $100,000 bought at $569 with no add-ons. Resets cost $228, then $456, then $912.

reset_where.sentence: You can reset a funded account from Trading Objectives on the dashboard.
reset_where.locator: 17437410: reset from Trading Objectives on the dashboard.

reset_where.sentence: The Reset options button sits next to Credentials.
reset_where.locator: 17437410: "The Reset options button sits next to Credentials on the dashboard."

reset_where.sentence: It shows the next reset price, or it shows No reset options on this account.
reset_where.locator: 17437410: it shows the price of the next reset, or "No reset options on this account."

reset_previous.sentence: A reset gives a fresh funded account.
reset_previous.locator: 17437410: "A reset gives you a fresh funded account."

reset_previous.sentence: Profit from the previous cycle is not paid.
reset_previous.locator: 17437410: "profit from the previous cycle is not paid."

fee_refund.sentence: On 1-Step, 2-Step, LITE 1-Step, and LITE 2-Step, the challenge fee is refunded with the third payout if you passed the evaluation on the first attempt with no Free Retry, never reset the account, and had no soft breach in those three payout cycles.
fee_refund.locator: 17437366: third payout on 1-Step, 2-Step, LITE 1-Step, and LITE 2-Step if the evaluation was passed on the first attempt with no Free Retry, the account was never reset, and those cycles had no soft breach.

fee_refund.sentence: A soft breach restarts the count, so three more clean payouts are needed.
fee_refund.locator: 17437366: "A soft breach restarts the count: you will need three more clean payouts."

fee_refund.sentence: Instant, Instant Elite, Flash Activation, and Catalyst have no fee refund.
fee_refund.locator: 17437366: "Instant, Instant Elite, Flash Activation and Catalyst have no fee refund."

payout_not_reversed.sentence: A completed payout is not reversed.
payout_not_reversed.locator: owner-final: a completed payout is not reversed.

source_primary.sentence: The Help Centre is the primary public policy reference.
source_primary.locator: owner-final: the Help Centre is the primary public policy reference.

source_primary.sentence: The repo FAQ does not override it.
source_primary.locator: owner-final: the repo FAQ does not override the Help Centre.
